title: artemisia ruthiae
intro: Artemisia ruthiae, commonly known as Russian tarragon, is a perennial herb belonging to the Asteraceae family. The health benefits of Artemisia ruthiae include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion, making it a popular ingredient in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Russian tarragon include its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce stress. The bioactive constituents of Artemisia ruthiae include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
